figures.caption: Fig. 1: Schematic of the recording protocol.

Fig. 2: Schematic of the recording setup. Laptop A runs the LabRecorder software, the tetris game, the script for recording keystrokes and the MuseLSL2 software to capture data from one participant. The laptop has a parallel monitor and keyboard for the other participant. Laptop B runs the MuseLSL2 software capturing the data from the other participant’s MUSE-S device.

Fig. 3: Shape of the augmented feature matrix for a) the full feature set and b) the feature set containing only inter-stream cross-coherence features. Vertical axis denotes frequency from 0 to 45 Hz in 0.5 Hz steps; horizontal axis denotes the features as listed in the text.

Fig. 4: Training loss and classification accuracy using the full feature set. The blue and red colors denote results obtained using training and testing data, respectively. The median and the range between 5 % and 95 % quantiles over the 50 runs are shown.

Fig. 5: Training loss and classification accuracy using only the inter-stream cross-coherence features. The blue and red colors denote results obtained using training and testing data, respectively. The median and the range between 5 % and 95 % quantiles over the 50 runs are shown.
